title: Instrument quote
description: What the agent service answers for GET /v1/quotes/{symbol}. Deterministic: the same market data the fact sheet is built from, with no model involved. It exists because the engine has no market data of its own and cannot otherwise value a holding it is not currently analysing - and the position limit is a share of that value. It is deliberately narrower than the fact sheet: P/E and sector are read by agents, a price is read by arithmetic.

price.description: The last price the provider reported, in the instrument's own currency.

currency.description: The currency the price is in. Not assumed to be USD: the engine refuses to mix currencies rather than converting behind anyone's back.

as_of.description: When the price was taken, not when it was asked for. The engine refuses to value a holding on a quote older than its policy allows, which it cannot do without this.

instrument.description: Echoed from the request rather than from the provider's response, so the symbol in an answer is always one that passed validation.

symbol.description: The same rule the engine's Ticker enforces, and the same one the signal contract uses.
